name: Jesus Looks
overview: The topic of "Jesus Looks" reveals a profound contrast between Christ's earthly appearance and His divine majesty. Isaiah 53 describes Jesus as having no outward form or beauty that would attract us, emphasizing His humble and unassuming physical presence. Yet, Revelation 19 portrays the glorified Christ with eyes like a flame of fire and crowned with many crowns, signifying His sovereign authority and divine power. Together, these verses underscore the mystery of Jesus' incarnation and exaltation, inviting believers to see beyond outward appearances to the glory revealed in Him.
